# 1.2.62 - every request to the GM, one way

The sixth stage on the way to 1.3.0. Everything a player's browser asks the
GM's browser to do now goes one way: one table says who may ask for what, one
list says why something was refused, and one function waits for the answer.
Players see the difference as clearer messages; nothing about what a player
may do has changed. Nothing here asks a world to be migrated.

## Changed

- **When the GM's client refuses something a player asked for, the player now
  sees what was not carried out and why**, in their own language (English or
  Polish). Before, they were told only that the GM's client refused.
- **A request that fails on the GM's side is reported once** to the player who
  asked, instead of silently never happening or keeping them waiting.
- **When no GM is connected, or the GM's client does not answer in time, every
  request gives the same single message**, and adds "Nothing was spent." when
  nothing was.
- **Actions no longer report success before the GM has carried them out**:
  taking an item from a body, a Level Up offer, sharing a project, an Eclipse
  move, the "sent" line of a Palm or a Steal, and the lines a Reroll writes. A
  discarded item leaves the sheet only once its trace is placed.
- **A Search in a room the character is not in is refused once, with the
  reason**; the search card then says only that the search was not counted.
- **When a Daggerheart feature asks for a change this game leaves to the GM,
  the player is told so.**
- Windows the GM panel or the Season setup closes in order to reopen them no
  longer wait for their closing animation.

## Checked

- The headless suite: 312 passed, 0 failed, 16 skipped, 0 red until a later
  stage. New in the suite: R161 to R168. New scenario 33-bridge-paths: every
  legal road through the bridge, measured before the change and after it; all
  35 of its checks pass. The security scenario keeps its 69 checks and gains
  two; the other scenarios end as they did on 1.2.61.
- An independent review in two parts (security, and whether the change is
  correct and its tests measure) found no blocker, two larger problems and
  eight smaller ones, all fixed here and each shown failing before it passed:
  a refusal that told a player a little more than it should about a trace
  (every refusal of that request now reads the same, after the same wait), a
  planted item whose late answer could be lost (it now goes back to the room
  for as long as the GM's side would take it back), and, among the smaller
  ones, success lines that could still appear before the GM's side had
  finished, and a trace the GM's client could not place being reported as
  placed. Checking those fixes turned up one more case, also fixed: a request
  the GM's side quietly could not carry out (taking an item that could not be
  taken, for one) was still reported as done; it is now refused.
- Not checked in a real Foundry yet, and listed in the audit's live checks
  (LIVE-E31-01 to 06): a real Reroll through the table, how long the GM's
  answer takes on a real server, a GM leaving in the middle of a request, a
  planted item answered after its time, the reopened windows with reduced
  motion, and a Polish player's refusal under an English GM. The local release
  gate needs a local Foundry v14 and did not run for this release.
